note: A scripted take. `at` is ms after the session opens; `say` is what gets synthesised into `file` by `npm run rehearsal`. Three cues on purpose: one the agent answers from what it knows, one that must call a tool, and one placed while it is still talking so the barge-in lane has something in it.

cues.say: Hi there. In one sentence, what does Whissle actually do?
What is the weather in San Francisco right now?
Sorry, hold on. What about London instead?
